guard: the built binary writes one envelope for version --json and for a usage error under --json, accepts --no-color and --no-input before and after the command word but not after --, turns color off under --no-color even for text computed at import, and refuses to open an editor under --no-input
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx bin/smoke/cli-entry.smoke.ts
why: Scripts reach these through the installed binary, so the suite drives the built binary and each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.
The title mutation restores the bug where help's title decided color when its module loaded, before the kernel read --no-color.

mutations.name: --no-color is accepted but ignored
mutations.expectRed: cotal --no-color help prints with no ANSI color
mutations.cell: cotal --no-color help prints with no ANSI color
mutations.command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx bin/smoke/cli-entry.smoke.ts

mutations.name: leading global flags are not read
mutations.expectRed: --no-input before the command word is accepted
mutations.cell: --no-input before the command word is accepted
mutations.command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx bin/smoke/cli-entry.smoke.ts

mutations.name: a global flag after -- is taken
mutations.expectRed: a global flag after -- is a word
mutations.cell: a global flag after -- is a word
mutations.command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx bin/smoke/cli-entry.smoke.ts

mutations.name: the usage envelope is not written for -j
mutations.expectRed: an unexpected argument under -j is a USAGE_INVALID envelope
mutations.cell: an unexpected argument under -j is a USAGE_INVALID envelope
mutations.command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx bin/smoke/cli-entry.smoke.ts

mutations.name: help's title decides color when it loads
mutations.find: const title = (): string => `${c.bold("cotal")} - lateral agent coordination over NATS`;
mutations.replace:
const titleAtLoad = `${c.bold("cotal")} - lateral agent coordination over NATS`;
const title = (): string => titleAtLoad;
mutations.expectRed: cotal --no-color help prints with no ANSI color
mutations.cell: cotal --no-color help prints with no ANSI color
mutations.command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx bin/smoke/cli-entry.smoke.ts

mutations.name: personas edit opens the editor under --no-input
mutations.expectRed: personas edit --no-input refuses to open an editor
mutations.cell: personas edit --no-input refuses to open an editor
mutations.command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx bin/smoke/cli-entry.smoke.ts
